cost_budgets_mode.title: Cost Budgets Mode
cost_budgets_mode.description: Off leaves requests untouched and blocks nothing, so it is a true rollback. Observe tracks spend per project and user without ever blocking a call, which is the safe way to measure real usage before choosing limits. Enforce rejects calls once a limit is exceeded.

cost_budgets_defaults_enabled.title: Apply Default Limits
cost_budgets_defaults_enabled.description: Apply the default limits below to projects and users that have no limit set explicitly. When disabled, anything without an explicit limit stays unlimited. Only used in enforce mode.

cost_budgets_project_monthly_limit.title: Default Team Project Limit (USD / month)
cost_budgets_project_monthly_limit.description: Monthly shared-model limit for team projects without an explicit limit. Leave empty for unlimited.

cost_budgets_personal_project_monthly_li.title: Default User Limit (USD / month)
cost_budgets_personal_project_monthly_li.description: Monthly shared-model limit for each user's own project, which is where API and token calls made without a project are billed. Leave empty for unlimited.

cost_budgets_user_monthly_limit.title: Default Per-Member Limit Inside A Project (USD / month)
cost_budgets_user_monthly_limit.description: Monthly limit for a single member's spend within a project, so one member cannot consume the whole project budget. Leave empty for unlimited.
